candidate.title: Archival claim rescue with preserved uncertainty
candidate.thesis: Test whether an explicitly specified linear contrast can be answered without selecting one transcription, preserving glyph ambiguity, shared calibration and sparse source errors. Established certain-answer and query-cleaning methods challenge novelty; flagship status is withheld.
candidate.goal: Return exact linear-contrast bounds over declared glyph alternatives, shared calibration offsets and sparse row errors, with extremal witnesses.
candidate.successMetric: Bounds and witnesses agree with an independently authored exhaustive oracle on every valid finite case; unsupported cases are refused. Technical correctness does not pass the separate novelty or market gate.

sources.title: Knowledge-Preserving Certain Answers for SQL-like Queries
sources.excerpt: The paper treats certainty over incomplete data, including bag semantics and value-inventing queries using arithmetic and aggregation. It is direct prior art against a broad claim that query-level certainty is newly invented.

sources.title: Cleaning Uncertain Data with Quality Guarantees
sources.excerpt: The authors use query information and possible-world semantics to choose which uncertain data to clean under limited resources, with quality measures and efficient algorithms. Query-directed uncertainty reduction is established prior art.

sources.title: Automation of historical weather data rescue
sources.excerpt: Zhang and Sieber describe a modular workflow combining layout processing and handwriting recognition for historical weather records, evaluated with DRAW material. This motivates the problem; it does not validate the present authored glyph or calibration sets. First published 26 September 2024.

witness.original_purpose: Answer an explicitly specified linear contrast of archived numerical measurements, preserving all declared transcription, calibration and source-error uncertainty.
witness.binding_restriction: A conventional transcribe-every-cell workflow postpones analysis until a single dataset is fixed; naive per-cell intervals discard shared calibration dependence.
witness.proposed_change: Compute the exact minimum and maximum of the unchanged query over an explicitly bounded set of admissible records and emit extremal witnesses. Permit a claim only if every admitted world supports it.
preserved_obligations: Unchanged specified weighted sum and threshold
Up to the complete stated number of signed row errors
Unresolved conclusions and failed cases remain visible
witness.acceptance_requirements: Exact lower/upper and valid extremal witnesses equal independent enumeration on every valid case; correctly refuse malformed and unsupported inputs.
falsifiers: Existing strong methods provide the same functional contract with no demonstrated additional capability or effort advantage.
Observed gain depends on dropping correlated uncertainty, assuming unsupported source calibration, or changing the query.
Usefulness disappears when the cost of constructing/validating the admissible set is included.
witness.source_scope: Research-authored finite possible-world cases, not source-verified historical data or a climate conclusion.
witness.prior_art_gate: Must document a substantive advance beyond certain-answer databases, query-guided cleaning, robust optimization and existing archive transcription tools. Efficient implementation or renaming alone fails. Current status: UNPROVEN.

rights.native_sources: Exact pinned upstream bytes with their original license notices
rights.data: Research-authored finite cases; no customer data or original historical measurement records
rights.external_literature: Linked with brief attributed paraphrases; original publisher papers and images are not redistributed by this bridge
rights.network_admission: Not granted; unsupported scientific scope is refused by unchanged production policy

uncertainty.novelty: UNPROVEN; established methods cover the core formulation, so no flagship award
uncertainty.useful_source_admissibility: Real handwriting alternatives, correlated calibration assumptions and source-error budgets are unvalidated
uncertainty.commercial: All demand, participation, prices, mission success and complete operating costs are conditional assumptions; actual collections zero
uncertainty.discovery_comparison: Single ordinary-prompt and expert-prompt agent searches; no human trial, repeated randomized model comparison or beyond-human inference
uncertainty.model_scope: independent finite glyph alternatives + shared group calibration choices + up to k bounded signed row errors

milestones.goal: Construct a bounded exact rational query instrument and extremal witnesses for the declared uncertainty model.
milestones.successMetric: Freeze source before fresh confirmation; preserve the original query, every declared alternative and shared dependence.
permissions: Local code and synthetic data only
No claim of source-certified archival reconstruction

milestones.goal: Run fresh fixed-seed cases against the independently authored exhaustive reference after source freezes.
milestones.successMetric: All valid-case exact bounds match; compare witnesses and competent conventional controls; retain every discrepancy without silent correction.
permissions: Generate cases only after both solver source hashes are frozen
Use local independent algorithms under one research controller

No new claim of beyond-human foresight
